observableStateContract.authority: Server activity semantics with read-only client presentation
acceptance: Immediate event feedback is visibly distinct from persistent round totals.
Points, lives, team counts, streaks, multipliers, countdowns and rewards are not inferred from frame-to-frame arithmetic.

Completion commits exactly once; retries reuse the existing receipt and cannot duplicate progression.
A failed durable commit remains pending and cannot falsely release or reward.
